$purpose: Configuration for tools/render_gate/mikage_render_gate_fal.py. Operator-editable. V0.1 ships with model_id=CHUA_XAC_NHAN as a deliberate safety stop — tool will refuse to call FAL until operator sets a concrete model_id.
$operator_unlock_procedure: 1. Operator sets project_metadata.operator_approval_token in the target brief JSON (separate edit; not done by this tool).
2. Operator edits this config and replaces model_id 'CHUA_XAC_NHAN' with a concrete FAL model id (e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/dev' or whatever model is approved for Mikage).
3. Operator exports FAL_KEY (or FAL_API_KEY) in their shell.
4. Operator runs: python tools/render_gate/mikage_render_gate_fal.py --brief <brief.json>   (omit --dry-run to actually call FAL).
5. After the run, Cowork drafts a verification report against the brief's verification_checklist (separate task — never automatic).
$safety_invariants: Tool MUST NOT call FAL when operator_approval_token is null in the brief.
Tool MUST NOT call FAL when model_id is CHUA_XAC_NHAN.
Tool MUST NOT call FAL when FAL_KEY / FAL_API_KEY env var is missing.
Tool MUST NOT modify the source brief JSON.
Tool MUST NOT mark any output PASS for visual quality.
Tool MUST NOT establish anchor_lyre_001 or any other anchor.
Tool MUST NOT edit any canon file.
Tool MUST NOT asset-lock any output.
